record.answer: One litre equals exactly 1,000 millilitres (1 L = 1,000 mL).
record.author: @adrian.factfinder
record.claim: One litre equals exactly 1,000 millilitres under the unit definitions.

evidence.locator: Section 3, Table 7 SI prefixes; printed p.138, PDF page 28, milli row
evidence.observation: The prefix milli, symbol m, has decimal factor 10^-3.
evidence.publisher: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures (BIPM)

evidence.locator: Section 4, Table 8 Non-SI units; printed p.140, PDF page 30, volume/litre row
evidence.observation: Litre symbols l and L denote the cubic decimetre, 10^-3 cubic metre.
evidence.publisher: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures (BIPM)

evidence.locator: Section 5.2 Unit symbols; printed p.142, PDF page 32, paragraph after litre-symbol exception
evidence.observation: A multiple/submultiple prefix precedes and forms part of the unit symbol without a separator.
evidence.publisher: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures (BIPM)

excluded_scopes: Measurement tolerance or uncertainty of a physical volume determination.
Accuracy of a measured container or its graduations.
Density, mass or any conversion between volume and mass.
Temperature-specific liquid behavior or volume change.
Historical litre definitions or retrospective conversion of historical measurements.

inference.exactness_basis: Decimal prefix factor and unit identity are definitional, rather than empirical container measurements.
inference.not_claimed: The brochure was not found to state the complete 1 L = 1,000 mL sentence verbatim in the checked passages.
steps: Apply milli to L: 1 mL = 10^-3 L.

limitations: Three evidence entries are locators in the same BIPM brochure and share one origin; no independent corroboration claim.

record.scope: Unit equivalence between litre and millilitre under the definitions and decimal prefix rules in the cited June 2026 brochure. Exactness applies to units, not to a physical measurement.
record.search_scope: Searched Fact-ori and Meta for C005 and checked handoff replies; no prior draft or competing claim found. Fetched the BIPM English V4.01 PDF and checked cover edition, Table 7, Table 8 and prefix rules via extracted text. PDF screenshot requests were also made; no saved source-byte digest or independent source corroboration is asserted. No unresolved retrieval blocker for the cited text.
